title: mR3: MULTILINGUAL RUBRIC-AGNOSTIC REWARD REASONING MODELS

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance (accuracy and F1 scores) across High-Resource (HRL), Medium-Resource (MRL), and Low-Resource Languages (LRL) to measure linguistic disparities in reasoning and reward modeling capabilities.
Evaluating the model using the INCLUDE-base-44 benchmark to assess its ability to provide culturally aware responses and accurately retrieve regional/cultural knowledge across 44 languages.

Measuring the first-position bias inherent in LLM-as-a-judge frameworks during pairwise comparisons (on the m-ArenaHard-v2.0 benchmark) by systematically placing the reference output in the first position.

Using the RTP-LX multilingual safety benchmark and specific rubrics to evaluate the model's capability to detect identity attacks, ethnic biases, microaggressions, and hateful slurs targeting specific demographic groups.
